scope: Native entry points to existing authenticated web connections, social publish and caption review routes.
authorization: Native per-clip controls require existing can_manage from clip_get. Browser establishes its own Auth session and rechecks creator rights and provider gates. No JWT, code, token, cookie, title, caption or source URL is transferred.
review: React review: event-driven navigation, no added polling or duplicate API access, accessible touch targets, existing account/generation cleanup, sanitized errors.
limitations: Browser may require the creator to sign in again.
No native OAuth token exchange or direct-publishing consent forms are implied.
Physical iOS/Android handoff and provider publishing are not accepted by local tests.
